def doMove (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with status := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.dst else s.status d,

/-!
# Document workflow specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the document workflow component. Candidates may not edit
this file. Documents move through draft, review, approved, published and archived along a
role-based transition table; authors edit drafts; an audit list records every accepted
transition in order. Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`;
the locked challenge (`Workflow/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the hole `Workflow.step`.
-/

namespace Workflow

abbrev DocId := Nat
abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Status where
  | draft
  | review
  | approved
  | published
  | archived
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Role where
  | guest
  | author
  | reviewer
  | publisher
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The transition table: `allowed role src dst` holds when a user with `role` may move a
document from `src` to `dst`. Every pair not listed is forbidden. -/
def allowed : Role → Status → Status → Bool
  | .author,    .draft,     .review    => true
  | .author,    .draft,     .archived  => true
  | .author,    .review,    .draft     => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .approved  => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .published => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .published, .archived  => true
  | _,          _,          _          => false

/-- One audit record: `actor` moved `doc` from `src` to `dst`. -/
structure Entry where
  doc   : DocId
  actor : UserId
  src   : Status
  dst   : Status
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: fixed document and user universes, each document's status and content, each
user's role, and the audit list (oldest entry first). -/
structure State where
  docs    : List DocId
  users   : List UserId
  status  : DocId → Status
  content : DocId → Nat
  role    : UserId → Role
  audit   : List Entry

inductive Kind where
  | move
  | edit
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `actor` asks to move `doc` to status `dst` (kind `move`, `body` ignored) or to replace its
content with `body` (kind `edit`, `dst` ignored). -/
structure Request where
  actor : UserId
  doc   : DocId
  kind  : Kind
  dst   : Status
  body  : Nat

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- The conditions under which a request must succeed: a move follows an edge of the table
for the actor's role; an edit is made by an author on a draft. -/
def ValidRequest (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  (r.kind = .move → allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true) ∧
  (r.kind = .edit → s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft)

/-- The status of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedStatus (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Status :=
  if r.kind = .move ∧ d = r.doc then r.dst else s.status d

/-- The content of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedContent (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Nat :=
  if r.kind = .edit ∧ d = r.doc then r.body else s.content d

/-- The audit list after a successful request: a move appends one entry, an edit none. -/
def expectedAudit (s : State) (r : Request) : List Entry :=
  if r.kind = .move then s.audit ++ [⟨r.doc, r.actor, s.status r.doc, r.dst⟩] else s.audit

/-- Replay an audit list for document `d`, starting from status `st`: the destination of the
last entry for `d`, or `st` if there is none. -/
def replay : List Entry → DocId → Status → Status
  | [], _, st => st
  | e :: es, d, st => replay es d (if e.doc = d then e.dst else st)

/-- The audit agrees with the state: replaying it from `draft` gives every document's status. -/
def AuditConsistent (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ d ∈ s.docs, replay s.audit d .draft = s.status d

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid request succeeds. -/

import Workflow.Spec
namespace Workflow

def doMove (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with status := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.dst else s.status d,
           audit := s.audit ++ [{ doc := r.doc, actor := r.actor, src := s.status r.doc, dst := r.dst }] }

def doEdit (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with content := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.body else s.content d }

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.docs.contains r.doc && s.users.contains r.actor then
    match r.kind with
    | .move => if allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst then (.ok, doMove s r) else (.rejected, s)
    | .edit => if s.role r.actor == .author && s.status r.doc == .draft then (.ok, doEdit s r) else (.rejected, s)
  else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds       : ValidSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop         : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_authorization        : Authorized step := by
  intro s r h
  constructor
  · intro hm
    unfold step at h
    rw [hm] at h
    simp only at h
    split at h
    · next hmem =>
      split at h
      · next ha => exact ha
      · next ha => simp at h
    · simp at h
  · intro he
    unfold step at h
    rw [he] at h
    simp only at h
    split at h
    · next hmem =>
      split at h
      · next ha =>
        have ha' := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp ha)
        have h1 : s.role r.actor == Role.author := by simpa using ha'.1
        have h2 : s.status r.doc == Status.draft := by simpa using ha'.2
        have hr : s.role r.actor = Role.author := by
          cases hrole : s.role r.actor <;> simp_all
        have hs : s.status r.doc = Status.draft := by
          cases hst : s.status r.doc <;> simp_all
        exact ⟨hr, hs⟩
      · next ha => simp at h
    · simp at h

theorem req_single_doc           : SingleDoc step := sorry

theorem req_published_immutable  : PublishedImmutable step := sorry

theorem req_no_unpublish         : NoUnpublish step := sorry

theorem req_effects              : Effects step := sorry

theorem req_audit_append_only    : AuditAppendOnly step := sorry

theorem req_audit_consistent     : KeepsAuditConsistent step := sorry

end Workflow

/-!
# Document workflow specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the document workflow component. Candidates may not edit
this file. Documents move through draft, review, approved, published and archived along a
role-based transition table; authors edit drafts; an audit list records every accepted
transition in order. Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`;
the locked challenge (`Workflow/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the hole `Workflow.step`.
-/

namespace Workflow

abbrev DocId := Nat
abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Status where
  | draft
  | review
  | approved
  | published
  | archived
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Role where
  | guest
  | author
  | reviewer
  | publisher
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The transition table: `allowed role src dst` holds when a user with `role` may move a
document from `src` to `dst`. Every pair not listed is forbidden. -/
def allowed : Role → Status → Status → Bool
  | .author,    .draft,     .review    => true
  | .author,    .draft,     .archived  => true
  | .author,    .review,    .draft     => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .approved  => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .published => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .published, .archived  => true
  | _,          _,          _          => false

/-- One audit record: `actor` moved `doc` from `src` to `dst`. -/
structure Entry where
  doc   : DocId
  actor : UserId
  src   : Status
  dst   : Status
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: fixed document and user universes, each document's status and content, each
user's role, and the audit list (oldest entry first). -/
structure State where
  docs    : List DocId
  users   : List UserId
  status  : DocId → Status
  content : DocId → Nat
  role    : UserId → Role
  audit   : List Entry

inductive Kind where
  | move
  | edit
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `actor` asks to move `doc` to status `dst` (kind `move`, `body` ignored) or to replace its
content with `body` (kind `edit`, `dst` ignored). -/
structure Request where
  actor : UserId
  doc   : DocId
  kind  : Kind
  dst   : Status
  body  : Nat

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- The conditions under which a request must succeed: a move follows an edge of the table
for the actor's role; an edit is made by an author on a draft. -/
def ValidRequest (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  (r.kind = .move → allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true) ∧
  (r.kind = .edit → s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft)

/-- The status of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedStatus (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Status :=
  if r.kind = .move ∧ d = r.doc then r.dst else s.status d

/-- The content of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedContent (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Nat :=
  if r.kind = .edit ∧ d = r.doc then r.body else s.content d

/-- The audit list after a successful request: a move appends one entry, an edit none. -/
def expectedAudit (s : State) (r : Request) : List Entry :=
  if r.kind = .move then s.audit ++ [⟨r.doc, r.actor, s.status r.doc, r.dst⟩] else s.audit

/-- Replay an audit list for document `d`, starting from status `st`: the destination of the
last entry for `d`, or `st` if there is none. -/
def replay : List Entry → DocId → Status → Status
  | [], _, st => st
  | e :: es, d, st => replay es d (if e.doc = d then e.dst else st)

/-- The audit agrees with the state: replaying it from `draft` gives every document's status. -/
def AuditConsistent (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ d ∈ s.docs, replay s.audit d .draft = s.status d

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid request succeeds. -/

import Workflow.Spec
namespace Workflow

def doMove (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with status := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.dst else s.status d,
           audit := s.audit ++ [{ doc := r.doc, actor := r.actor, src := s.status r.doc, dst := r.dst }] }

def doEdit (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with content := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.body else s.content d }

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.docs.contains r.doc && s.users.contains r.actor then
    match r.kind with
    | .move => if allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst then (.ok, doMove s r) else (.rejected, s)
    | .edit => if s.role r.actor == .author && s.status r.doc == .draft then (.ok, doEdit s r) else (.rejected, s)
  else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds       : ValidSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop         : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_authorization        : Authorized step := by
  intro s r h
  constructor
  · intro hm
    unfold step at h
    rw [hm] at h
    simp only at h
    split at h
    · next hmem =>
      split at h
      · next ha => exact ha
      · next ha => simp at h
    · simp at h
  · intro he
    unfold step at h
    rw [he] at h
    simp only at h
    split at h
    · next hmem =>
      split at h
      · next ha =>
        have ha' := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp ha)
        have h1 : s.role r.actor == Role.author := by simpa using ha'.1
        have h2 : s.status r.doc == Status.draft := by simpa using ha'.2
        have hr : s.role r.actor = Role.author := by
          cases hrole : s.role r.actor <;> simp_all
        have hs : s.status r.doc = Status.draft := by
          cases hst : s.status r.doc <;> simp_all
        exact ⟨hr, hs⟩
      · next ha => simp at h
    · simp at h

theorem req_single_doc           : SingleDoc step := sorry

theorem req_published_immutable  : PublishedImmutable step := sorry

theorem req_no_unpublish         : NoUnpublish step := sorry

theorem req_effects              : Effects step := sorry

theorem req_audit_append_only    : AuditAppendOnly step := sorry

theorem req_audit_consistent     : KeepsAuditConsistent step := sorry

end Workflow

import Workflow.Spec
namespace Workflow

def doMove (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with status := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.dst else s.status d,
           audit := s.audit ++ [{ doc := r.doc, actor := r.actor, src := s.status r.doc, dst := r.dst }] }

def doEdit (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with content := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.body else s.content d }

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.docs.contains r.doc && s.users.contains r.actor then
    match r.kind with
    | .move => if allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst then (.ok, doMove s r) else (.rejected, s)
    | .edit => if s.role r.actor == .author && s.status r.doc == .draft then (.ok, doEdit s r) else (.rejected, s)
  else (.rejected, s)

        have hr : s.role r.actor = Role.author := by

        have hs : s.status r.doc = Status.draft := by
          cases hst : s.status r.doc <;> simp_all
        exact ⟨hr, hs⟩
      · next ha => simp at h
    · simp at h

/-!
# Document workflow specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the document workflow component. Candidates may not edit
this file. Documents move through draft, review, approved, published and archived along a
role-based transition table; authors edit drafts; an audit list records every accepted
transition in order. Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`;
the locked challenge (`Workflow/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the hole `Workflow.step`.
-/

namespace Workflow

abbrev DocId := Nat
abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Status where
  | draft
  | review
  | approved
  | published
  | archived
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Role where
  | guest
  | author
  | reviewer
  | publisher
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The transition table: `allowed role src dst` holds when a user with `role` may move a
document from `src` to `dst`. Every pair not listed is forbidden. -/
def allowed : Role → Status → Status → Bool
  | .author,    .draft,     .review    => true
  | .author,    .draft,     .archived  => true
  | .author,    .review,    .draft     => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .approved  => true
  | .reviewer,  .review,    .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .published => true
  | .publisher, .approved,  .draft     => true
  | .publisher, .published, .archived  => true
  | _,          _,          _          => false

/-- One audit record: `actor` moved `doc` from `src` to `dst`. -/
structure Entry where
  doc   : DocId
  actor : UserId
  src   : Status
  dst   : Status
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: fixed document and user universes, each document's status and content, each
user's role, and the audit list (oldest entry first). -/
structure State where
  docs    : List DocId
  users   : List UserId
  status  : DocId → Status
  content : DocId → Nat
  role    : UserId → Role
  audit   : List Entry

inductive Kind where
  | move
  | edit
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `actor` asks to move `doc` to status `dst` (kind `move`, `body` ignored) or to replace its
content with `body` (kind `edit`, `dst` ignored). -/
structure Request where
  actor : UserId
  doc   : DocId
  kind  : Kind
  dst   : Status
  body  : Nat

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- The conditions under which a request must succeed: a move follows an edge of the table
for the actor's role; an edit is made by an author on a draft. -/
def ValidRequest (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.doc ∈ s.docs ∧
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  (r.kind = .move → allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst = true) ∧
  (r.kind = .edit → s.role r.actor = .author ∧ s.status r.doc = .draft)

/-- The status of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedStatus (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Status :=
  if r.kind = .move ∧ d = r.doc then r.dst else s.status d

/-- The content of document `d` after a successful request. -/
def expectedContent (s : State) (r : Request) (d : DocId) : Nat :=
  if r.kind = .edit ∧ d = r.doc then r.body else s.content d

/-- The audit list after a successful request: a move appends one entry, an edit none. -/
def expectedAudit (s : State) (r : Request) : List Entry :=
  if r.kind = .move then s.audit ++ [⟨r.doc, r.actor, s.status r.doc, r.dst⟩] else s.audit

/-- Replay an audit list for document `d`, starting from status `st`: the destination of the
last entry for `d`, or `st` if there is none. -/
def replay : List Entry → DocId → Status → Status
  | [], _, st => st
  | e :: es, d, st => replay es d (if e.doc = d then e.dst else st)

/-- The audit agrees with the state: replaying it from `draft` gives every document's status. -/
def AuditConsistent (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ d ∈ s.docs, replay s.audit d .draft = s.status d

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid request succeeds. -/

import Workflow.Spec
namespace Workflow

def doMove (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with status := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.dst else s.status d,
           audit := s.audit ++ [{ doc := r.doc, actor := r.actor, src := s.status r.doc, dst := r.dst }] }

def doEdit (s : State) (r : Request) : State :=
  { s with content := fun d => if d == r.doc then r.body else s.content d }

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.docs.contains r.doc && s.users.contains r.actor then
    match r.kind with
    | .move => if allowed (s.role r.actor) (s.status r.doc) r.dst then (.ok, doMove s r) else (.rejected, s)
    | .edit => if s.role r.actor == .author && s.status r.doc == .draft then (.ok, doEdit s r) else (.rejected, s)
  else (.rejected, s)

        have h2 : s.status r.doc == Status.draft := by simpa using ha'.2
        have hr : s.role r.actor = Role.author := by

        have hs : s.status r.doc = Status.draft := by

        exact ⟨hr, hs⟩

    · simp at h
